title: Yours Truly, a Max x20 User
description:
Anthropic, this has to stop.

Every day it's something new. Credits here, credits there. Weekly credits. Sonnet, Opus, Fable. Five-hour limits. Weekly limits.

Miss one morning check and I don't even know the rules anymore.

We just wanna pay you and work. That's it.

I know compute is expensive. That's your problem to solve, not ours to stress over.

Does this get better or worse from here? Comment below and hit the poll.

#ClaudeAI
#ClaudeCode
#AItools
#Anthropic
#AIcommunity
transcript: Dear Anthropic, this has to stop. Seriously, we've had enough of this entire situation. Every day it's something new. >> We've just increased the limits for a few more days. Credits here, credits there. Weekly credits, Sonnet usage, Opus usage, Fable credits, 5-hour limits, weekly limits. Are you guys at Anthropic actually okay? Do you all have any idea what customer care and customer experience even mean? You've turned this whole service into a source of stress for a lot of us. The rules change every day. If I don't check the app in the morning, I won't know about your special conditions. We just want to pay you, relax, and know that we're getting the service that we're paying for. I mean, seriously, who even came up with this credit and usage system? And why there seems to be an obsession with credits and limits? And look, I'm only slightly autistic. I know this compute is expensive. We all get that. But that's y'alls problem to figure out. At this point, it almost feels like an addict checking their supply to see when it's going to run dry. It's really gotten out of hand. So, do me a solid, hit the poll in the description. Do we think companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are going to rethink this whole thing before it gets worse, or will it just continue to get worse? I'm hopeful. Just hit the poll.
